f2f56c2f-a421-408c-b510-5154feec12f6.name: Attune with Aether
rules: Search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle. You get {E}{E} (two energy counters).

accfcde8-428b-4579-ae3c-474eb091745d.name: Radiation
rules: At the beginning of each player's precombat main phase, if that player has one or more rad counters, mill that many cards. For each nonland card milled this way, you lose 1 life and remove one rad counter.
